summary: Re-verified against the current tree (grind pass, 2026-08-04): the tree had moved substantially since this map was last written — an intervening owner-review-1 pass had already built the search modal, the +new session/workspace dialog, and the workspace-files wiring that this map still called 'missing'/'not-wired'. This pass re-measured every non-match item against the live prototype markup (design/prototype/Clio Session.html, not guesswork), fixed the remaining real gaps, and corrected the map. Fixed this pass: the topbar's cyan hover now carries the measured background+border tint (was color-only) and the icon-only observability eye correctly gets no background tint (border+color only, per the prototype's own style-hover); the rail's New(+) button now hovers cyan/bordered, distinct from Search's neutral hover (previously identical); the search trigger's accessible name now reads the prototype's full title text; the search modal's header is now the prototype's single icon+input+close row instead of an extra 'search' title bar the app had invented; search's workspace rows now navigate (open that workspace's files) instead of being a dead no-op on click AND on Enter; the rail's 'open in files' workspace-menu action had a real bug — it shared one piece of state with the +new dialog's own workspace pre-selection, so opening files for workspace B could silently show workspace A (whichever session happened to be active) instead; fixed by giving each affordance its own state, with a regression test locking the CLICKED workspace wins. The 'agents' footer cell now carries a title describing what it actually does (connection switching) rather than promising nothing; Settings already has its own Agents page, so the prototype's 'opens settings' contract has a real path alongside the connection-switch click. Genuinely unresolved this pass: the hierarchy ribbon is still hardcoded to 'main' — populating it needs Call()-block click wiring in the transcript surface (HandoffPart.tsx, outside this surface's file boundary) plus a focus-stack navigation model the app does not have yet; it duplicates work already tracked as a separate task (E9, 'new Call-agent grammar') and was not built here to avoid a shallow, half-wired duplicate of that effort. The 'relay' footer cell remains a deliberate, documented degrade pending clio-agent#1179 (no reachability endpoint exists).

items.element: Hierarchy ribbon (row directly under the topbar)
items.proto_truth: data-driven breadcrumb of the currently-focused agent hierarchy (`{{ ribbon }}` sc-for): starts at 'main', gains a hop for each child agent the user has navigated into (e.g. 'main › geospatial'), the active/live hop shows a small orange pulsing dot (animation:clio-pulse), each hop is clickable and jumps back to that depth (`go: () => this.setFocus(focus.slice(0, i+1))`)
items.app_evidence: Re-verified, unchanged — still a real gap, NOT built this pass. apps/web/src/session/SessionView.tsx (`ribbon={[{ id: 'main', label: 'main' }]}` — still hardcoded); apps/web/src/shell/AppShell.tsx:130-138 (the ribbon RENDERING primitive is ready — it's a plain Tabs list driven entirely by the `ribbon` prop, so it already supports N hops and correct active/inactive coloring); apps/web/src/transcript/parts/HandoffPart.tsx (the Call()/child-card block) has zero navigation affordance — no onClick, no callback prop — confirmed via grep across apps/web/src/transcript for any 'scope'/'onFocusChild' reference: none exist anywhere in transcript rendering. WHY NOT FIXED HERE: populating this needs (1) a click handler on Call() blocks in HandoffPart.tsx — outside this surface's file boundary (transcript-parts, not rail-and-topbar) — and (2) a focus-stack navigation model this app does not have at all (the prototype's version doesn't just highlight a ribbon hop, it SWAPS THE ENTIRE TRANSCRIPT to show the child agent's own view — a materially bigger feature than a breadcrumb). This exact work is already tracked as a separate, in-progress task ('E9 implementation — new Call-agent grammar'); building a shallow version here (a ribbon hop with no corresponding transcript swap behind it) would be a half-wired duplicate of that effort, not a fix.
items.backend_surface: the session/turn data needed (child session ids, live status) is reachable via the same GET /v1/sessions/{id} + turn data the transcript itself renders from — not a missing endpoint, a cross-surface client feature
items.fix_hint: WIRE GAP — carried forward as E9, not fixed here. Populate `ribbon` from a child-agent focus stack (push a hop when a Call(...) block is followed, pop on back-navigation), give the active/live hop the orange clio-pulse dot, and — the larger piece — build the corresponding view-swap so entering a hop actually shows that child's own transcript, matching the prototype's `setFocus`/`viewVals` model rather than just relabeling the current one.
